Sword.name: Recruits Broadsword
Sword.description: A standard steel sword with dependable slashing motions.

Spear.name: Ironwood Pike
Spear.description: Lances through targets ahead, allowing safer offensive range. Requires both hands.

Dagger.name: Stiletto Shard
Dagger.description: Vicious rapid attacks boasting high precision.

Hammer.name: Granite Mallet
Hammer.description: Slow, heavy, devastating swings which knock entities back.

Staff.name: Elder Conduit Stave
Staff.description: Harnesses absolute spiritual flow to focus projection beads at distance. Requires both hands.

Bow.name: Recruits Recurve Bow
Bow.description: A physical ranged weapon with long reach. Shoots piercing arrows. Requires both hands.

Wand.name: Apprentice Spark Wand
Wand.description: A light magic conduit. Projects electric spark beads at distance.

Crossbow.name: Alloy Windlass Crossbow
Crossbow.description: A heavy 2-handed mechanical crossbow of incredible force. Requires both hands.

Greatsword.name: Mithril Zweihander
Greatsword.description: A colossal 2-handed greatsword with wide slashing curves. Requires both hands.

Warhammer.name: Volcanic Skullsplitter
Warhammer.description: A colossal 2-handed crushing hammer that obliterates armor. Requires both hands.
